newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson Dental EPS up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Patterson Dental EPS up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Wednesday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Patterson Dental Co to $1.48 a share from $1.40 and its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.70 from $1.60.
-- The six-month price target was raised to $30 from $28 a share and its 18-month target to $34 from $32.
-- Shares on Wednesday were off 1/4 at $27-3/4.

-- Patterson, the largest dental products distributor in the United States, has seen a return of growth in equipment, EVEREN said. "The improvement in growth in equipment adds $0.06 per share to our FY April 1997 EPS estimate, and $0.06 to our FY April 1998 EPS estimate," EVEREN said.
-- The remainder of the earnings outlook increase comes from the inclusion of Colwell, a medical forms business that Patterson is acquiring.
-- EVEREN said it projects Colwell will add $0.02 a share to earnings for fiscal 1997 and $0.04 to fiscal 1998.
-- EVEREN's rating on Patterson Dental is outperform.
